profile.headline: Fullstack engineer that leverages AI to develop solutions in modern frameworks and technologies
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the telecommunications industry. Skilled in web application development with a concentration of Angular 6+ and Angular 1.X. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor's of Science focused in Electronics Engineering Technology that is interested in utilizing micro-frontends along with a serverless architecture for my next project.

positions.title: UI Developer
positions.description:
* Utilize Angular 14 to develop a modern UI for internal enterprise projects
* Use TDD (Test Driven Development) to develop tested features that meet at minimum 92% SonarCube coverage
* Work with business analysts and product owners to prioritize features and give accurate estimates
* Lead the development and maintenance of front-end projects across multiple business domains

positions.title: Software Development Specialist
positions.description:
• Maintain legacy applications using AngularJs 1.X
    • Guide offshore resources towards the best implementation for new functionality during a sprint
    • Perform research and development on new initiatives to increase team productivity and value of existing applications
    • Design and develop reporting applications utilizing Angular 7

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
• Utilized AngularJs, CSS3, and HTML5 to develop a reactive internal user interface for a telecommunications client
    • Developed the skills of junior developers for increased productivity and to meet demands for higher work volume
    • Designed the code-base according to community standards to allow for reusable components and easy parallel development
    • Accurately estimated tasks 
    • Proposed solutions to technical GUI issues to upper levels of management

positions.title: IT Developer II
positions.description:
• Participated in all phases of the software development life cycle pertaining to the localization of the project
    • Followed Scrum procedures
    • Developed the UI for an integral integration module utilizing Angular JS
    • Lead or assist in the design, development, and maintenance of consumer and associate facing applications

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Participated in the research, design, and development of company proximity and geo-fence web (JSF) and mobile (Android 10 -17) solutions
    • Created and documented REST APIs that are used in each aspect of the product offering
    • Develop software to be executed on company hardware product
    • Integrate business ideas into viable software solutions

positions.title: Help Desk Technician (Student Worker)
positions.description:
*   Assembled and tested hardware for student and staff     
    workstations.
*   Installed software, such as operating systems, drivers, and all 
    applications on student and staff workstations.
*   Applied knowledge of system hardware and software to      
    understand and resolve technical problems.
*   Provided creative solutions to customer problems to ensure 
    customer satisfaction and productivity.
*   Researched, resolved, and responded to complex questions 
    received via telephone calls and in-person while providing 
    support on electronic services in accordance with current 
    policies and standards.
*   Handled incidents, projects, or escalations as assigned.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
*   Created web applications.
*   Wrote code based off of graphical images and debugged software.
*   Used various languages in Aptana IDE.
*   Entered MyApp is better contest

positions.title: Electronic Technician
positions.description:
*   Troubleshot PCB boards.
*   Ordered, de-soldered, and re-soldered components.
*   Came up with unorthodox solutions to interesting technical 
    problems.

patents.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DELIVERING TARGETED CONTENT TO MOBILE DEVICE USERS BASED ON GEO-LOCATION
patents.description: Delivering content using location data from mobile operators, GPS, or Wifi to mobile phone users when they are within a geo-fenced area.
